notes.title: Patch Notes: 05/01/2017 / Full Release
notes.notes:
Hi Guys & Girls XD

The following has been added to BM2:

1. 15 brand new levels. (All 100 levels are now available)
2. 2 new secret levels. (10 secret levels are available to find in the game)

Full Release

BM2 is now ready for final release, we just want to test a few more things but once those things are tested BM2 will be fully released XD

Much Love
ABI7ITY & FAY

notes.title: Patch Notes: 23/11/2017
notes.notes:
Hi Guys & Girls XD

The following has been added to BM2:

1. 20 brand new levels.
2. New trap doors that can be found throughout the game.
3. Some minor bug fixes and performance boost that was being experienced on some computers.

notes.title: Patch Notes: 03/10/2017
notes.notes:
Hi peeps.

 Bug fixes: 
1. Fixed a bug that was not allowing the "1st pizza collected" achievement to unlock.

Changes
1. Updated the adverts for Box Maze 1 and Family Skins Pack discounts on the main menu.
2. Made Hidden Message Achievements 6 - 10 unlockable once completing level 49 (these few hidden messages have not been added to the game itself as yet but will be added during Early Access, we just want you to be able to unlock all the achievements at all stages on EA )

Much Love
ABI7ITY
